paragraphs: Today I am in Leo's room. Leo is my classmate, and he is very funny. Look at the first picture. This is Leo's room, and many things are on the floor. Here is his bed. A blue blanket is on the floor. A wet towel is on the blanket. Here is the wall, and it is very big. A poster of a famous robot is on the wall. The robot has a round head and two red eyes.

Now look at the second picture. This is the desk, and the laptop is on it. A comic is open on the floor next to the desk. A model boat is on the shelf. The shelf is weak, and it goes down. This is Leo's chair, and a sock is on it. Two more socks are under the chair. The desk is bad, but the floor is worse! "Is this a room or a shop?" I ask. "It is a room," says Leo, and he laughs.

Now Leo's mom stands at the door. She says, "Leo, take your things off the floor." Leo puts the blanket on his bed. He puts the comic on the desk and the towel on the chair. I put the model boat on the desk, too. Look at the last picture of the room. The floor is clean now. "Where is my sock?" asks Leo. It is on his head, and we all laugh!
text.summary: Lily shows three pictures of her classmate Leo's room. Each sentence names a thing in a picture, and Leo's mom helps him with his things.
